events.municipality: Municipality of the County of Victoria
events.sourceNotes: The official twelve-row result table and tender terms were visually reviewed. Two SOLD/PAID rows and one NOT SOLD row publish explicit statuses; the other nine rows publish a Total Owing but no status or successful bid and stay fail-closed as outcome unknown. The pre-sale property listing is no longer published officially and has no archive capture, so result rows could not be reconciled to a notice listing; the retained notice announcement and tender terms pin the tender method and the noon deadline. Owner fields were deliberately omitted from this public dataset.

events.municipality: Municipality of the County of Victoria
events.sourceNotes: The official six-row result table was visually reviewed. One SOLD row and one NOT SOLD row are included. One DEFERRED row and three PAID rows publish no Total Owing or successful bid and are excluded because this public schema requires a positive advertised amount; the exclusions are itemized in the source ledger. The included SOLD row's AAN is published with seven digits and is retained exactly as printed. The pre-sale property listing has since been cleared from the municipal site, so result rows could not be reconciled to a notice listing. Owner fields were deliberately omitted from this public dataset.

events.municipality: Municipality of the County of Victoria
events.sourceNotes: The official fifteen-row result table, auction announcement, and housekeeping rules were visually reviewed. Three SOLD rows and one NOT SOLD row are included, plus one row published as REMOVED beside a printed successful bid that is kept fail-closed as withdrawn with no winning bid. Ten REMOVED rows publish no Total Owing and are excluded; the exclusions are itemized in the source ledger. The linked property-listing page has since been cleared, so the notice hash pins the announcement-page HTML snapshot retrieved on 2026-07-23. Owner fields were deliberately omitted from this public dataset.

events.municipality: Cape Breton Regional Municipality
events.sourceNotes: Every one of the 74 official result rows was checked against the rendered pages, not only extracted text. The table's yellow row highlighting is redundant with the printed WINNING BID column - all 74 rows agree - so no outcome depends on visual emphasis. Fifty rows publish a winning bid and one prints REDEEMED; five PAID AT SALE, four WALKED AWAY, and thirteen blank rows publish no winning bid and stay outcome-unknown with the official wording preserved. Lien 25-178 (PID 15440050) is excluded because the live NSPRD service returns no parcel for that PID. CBRM's pre-sale notice PDFs have been removed from the municipal site, so the notice receipt is the official CBRM tax-sales page captured on 2025-07-14, which pins the July 22, 2025 11:00 a.m. in-person public auction at Centre 200, Sydney. The assessed-name column was discarded before this dataset was written.

events.municipality: Municipality of the County of Cumberland
events.sourceNotes: The twenty-row October 21, 2025 result table was visually reviewed in the November 13, 2025 archive capture and re-verified row-for-row against an independent January 22, 2026 capture. Nineteen rows publish a winning bid. One row publishes NOT COMPLETED with no amount and stays fail-closed as outcome unknown. Cumberland publishes its tax-sale notice and its results at one address that is overwritten each sale, so the pre-sale property listing for this sale is no longer published and no archive capture of it survives; the archived result page therefore serves as both the notice and the result receipt. Assessment numbers and location descriptions are reproduced exactly as printed, which leaves seven-digit assessment values without their leading zero and keeps descriptions in the municipality's upper case; case was not normalized because doing so would corrupt names such as MCGEE and MCDOUGAL. Owner fields were deliberately omitted from this public dataset.

events.municipality: Municipality of the County of Cumberland
events.sourceNotes: The fourteen-row March 3, 2026 result table was visually reviewed in the April 15, 2026 archive capture and re-verified row-for-row against a May 9, 2026 capture and against a live retrieval of the page on July 23, 2026. Eight rows publish a winning bid. Six rows publish ADJORNED, the municipality's own spelling of adjourned, and are recorded as withdrawn with no winning bid. Cumberland publishes its tax-sale notice and its results at one address that is overwritten each sale, so the pre-sale property listing for this sale is no longer published and no archive capture of it survives; the archived result page therefore serves as both the notice and the result receipt. Assessment numbers and location descriptions are reproduced exactly as printed, which leaves seven-digit assessment values without their leading zero and keeps descriptions in the municipality's upper case; case was not normalized because doing so would corrupt names such as MCGEE and MCDOUGAL. Owner fields were deliberately omitted from this public dataset.

events.municipality: Municipality of the District of Lunenburg
events.sourceNotes: Tender 2020-01-009. The official tender package supplied the advertised listings and minimum opening bids, and the municipality's per-property award documents supplied the winning bids; each award document is receipted individually in the source ledger. MODL publishes assessment account numbers but not PIDs, so every PID here was derived by matching the account's PVSC coordinate against the NSPRD parcel layer rather than read from the notice. The result receipt is the municipality's awards page as retrieved, because MODL publishes no consolidated result table. Assessed-owner and bidder identities carried on the official sources were deliberately omitted from this public dataset.

events.sourceNotes: The dated official result PDF publishes 21 exact AAN/PID rows: 18 numeric selling prices and 3 rows printed Removed. Removed rows are recorded as withdrawn with no selling price. events.municipality: Region of Queens Municipality
events.sourceNotes: The municipality's self-contained result sheet publishes all 16 assessment numbers, property details, minimum bids, and printed outcomes: 4 numeric successful bids, 2 No successful bids rows, and 10 REMOVED rows. The sheet does not publish PIDs or redemption status. Each PID was derived deterministically by matching the account's PVSC open-data coordinate against the NSPRD parcel layer; all 16 accounts resolved to exactly one PID on 2026-08-06. The assessed-owner column was omitted before this public dataset was written.
